The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

Regarding the effectiveness of the encryption methods mentioned in the provided text: The text describes the implementation of AES-256 bit encryption. AES-256 is widely regarded as highly effective and secure. It uses a 256-bit key length, which creates a vast number of possible key combinations (2^256), making it computationally infeasible for current technology to break through brute-force attacks. Therefore, the assessment in the text that it is "very secure" and "nearly impervious to brute-force attacks" is accurate.
